title: ML's Pride Mod
description: A mod that adds a bunch of Pride flags to Minecraft
body:
A simple mod that adds 15 pride flags and some bonus stuff!

Flags (as of 1.0) :
Rainbow Flag
Inclusive Flag
Lesbian Flag
Gay Flag
Bi Flag
trans Flag
Queer Flag
Intersex Flag
Aroace Flag
Pan Flag
Genderfluid Flag
Nonbinary Flag
Aromantic Flag
Asexual Flag
Straight Ally Flag
